accepted_claims: A campaign plan can be admitted fail-closed only when permit/source/candidate/profile/platform bindings match exactly and every planned resource limit remains within the permit.
Sequential-repeat and nested-parallelism rules are machine-checkable before dispatch; parallel repeat copies and process/thread oversubscription are rejected.
Worst reserved vCPU consumption is reproducible with exact integer/rational arithmetic from allocated vCPUs, timeout, jobs and sequential repeats without conflating runner wall time with CPU time.
Every attempt, including TIMEOUT, RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED and CRASH, can be retained durably as canonical fsynced JSONL and non-success terminals cannot be promoted to PASS.
Paid tariff authority fails closed unless explicitly marked current/verified; issue existence, placeholders and model-only self-tests cannot authorize native or paid execution.
open_claims: No native geometry campaign has been executed under this harness.
No candidate has been qualified against MC-RH-Q1 or the MC-004 T0/T1/T2 ladder.
Windows/Linux fault and replay qualification remains owned by later tasks.
Provider-specific billing, runner behaviour and monetary projections must be verified prospectively for each actual campaign permit.
MC-B, MC-C, MC-D, MC-E, MC-F and MC-1 remain NOT_ESTABLISHED.
adversarial_controls: retain three successful repeats in strict sequential order

review.disposition: accept the static fail-closed campaign admission/accounting harness; retain actual native execution as separately permit-gated downstream work
review.downstream_release: later native-campaign tasks may consume the harness artifact but must supply their own valid versioned NATIVE_BOUNDED permit and retained evidence

downstream_invalidations: Changing MC-004 repeat/resource semantics invalidates the corresponding MC-045 admission/accounting assumptions and requires review.
Changing MC-009 canonical evidence-binding semantics invalidates the attempt/binding format use until reconciled.
Any downstream runner that bypasses exact permit binding, sequential repeats, nested-parallelism caps or durable failure retention cannot claim MC-045 compliance.
